methodology.scope: Synthetic article; independent fresh browser processes/profiles per trial. Original/baseline use identical current wrappers and SDK without Scribyra shell/cache; app measures complete current application including verification/storage. Original is the pinned texlive-extra collection, not a historical editor build.
methodology.network: Server response body bytes actually written over uncompressed loopback HTTP, including service-worker precaching. Excludes headers/TLS; warm/offline phases are separate. The server refuses all connections during offline reload/compile in addition to Playwright offline mode. Browser-managed update attempts are recorded as blocked. Not compressed internet transfer or timing.
methodology.memory: Linux process tree sampled every 250 ms from status and smaps_rollup; RSS double-counts shared pages, PSS proportions them. Peaks are observed lower bounds, not exact maxima. Workers may share processes. WASM capacities are observed at instantiate/grow/postMessage and phase boundaries using weak references; these are not committed/resident memory. Chromium worker heap/backing storage is sampled separately via CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage; no equivalent JS heap claim is made for Firefox/WebKit.
methodology.limits: Headless Linux desktop; no mobile claim. Browser/OS caches may retain system-level file pages. Instrumentation and sampler overhead are included; trials run serially.
